assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: standalone pixel-art keepsake illustration for the Chinese game Midnight Radiology. Image 1 is the edit target, used to preserve the established game's coarse pixel clusters, chunky dark outlines, limited gray/teal/amber palette and small-object framing. Replace the toolbox and all its contents with one handmade cloth pouch for medical-image CD cases, sewn by an elderly retired seamstress as a thank-you gift. Faded warm indigo cotton with a subtle tiny beige check weave, two roomy sewn compartments, one small label pocket, a flap folded back so its construction is clear. ONE unlabelled closed clear plastic CD case partially peeks out of a compartment, no patient data. Soft worn fabric, careful stitching; no needles, pins or loose tools. Match the reference's crisp visible square pixel clusters, hand-dithered material shading, old-school adventure-game inventory art. Do NOT make smooth digital painting, vector art, glossy 3D or photorealism. Center the entire object in a square image with generous empty margin, readable when shown at 96px. Three-quarter view consistent with reference, soft upper-left light. Genuinely transparent background (alpha), no surface, no cast shadow backdrop. Remove any existing lettering/watermark from the reference. No letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks or border. Output only this one object, not a sprite sheet or comparison.
